rationale: Both responses give the same correct argument. The numerator is nonnegative, so the fraction is negative exactly when the numerator is positive (x not equal to +-9) and the denominator x(x - 36) is negative (0 < x < 36). Removing x = 9 gives (0,9) U (9,36). B adds the remark that the fraction equals 0 at x = 9, and A is a little more compact. Neither has a gap, so they are equally sound and clear.
